messages:
olga_release: kicking off midnight changewindow canary for model-proxy v9.0.0 — doing a quick obs sweep before widening, canary 10%.
deploy-bot: Canary started service=model-proxy version=v9.0.0 env=prod region=eu-central-1 canary=10% (id=cb-1768301111) :rocket:
tom_sre: pulling key signals: p95, 5xx by route, 429s, kvcache miss-rate, and queue depth. baseline p95=95ms.
maya_ops: seeing a small 5xx rise: +6 on /batch-infer in last 5m. alert-bot hasn't fired yet.
olga_release: (typo) olga_release: ignore previous, typo.
tom_sre: query I ran: `sum(increase(http_requests_total{job=\"model-proxy\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (route)` -> /batch-infer: +6
maya_ops: host breakdown shows errors from node eu-c-11 only. stack shows redis timeout in sharded cache client.
olga_release: threshold for pause is >18 errors or p95 delta >25%. we are below. propose watch-and-pin if it persists.
tom_sre: alert-bot check: no slo breaches; but transient redis timeouts could amplify as traffic scales.
maya_ops: hotfix ETA ~35m to add backoff; alternative is partial pin /batch-infer to v8.9.3 for canary traffic.
olga_release: prefer partial pin to avoid rollback. maya_ops can you run the pin and note in release notes? also add ephemeral alert to watch queue depth.
maya_ops: running: `tools/routerctl pin /batch-infer --from v9.0.0 --to v8.9.3 --percent 100 --scope=canary`
deploy-bot: Route pin applied (/batch-infer -> v8.9.3) for canary id=cb-1768301111 :white_check_mark:
maya_ops: errors on /batch-infer dropped to baseline within 70s. p95 stable. cluster eu-c-11 still shows higher kvcache miss-rate, collecting traces.
tom_sre: created ephemeral watch rule: if 5xx delta over 5m for /batch-infer >10 OR p95 increase >20% -> page oncall. set for 20m.
olga_release: noting partial pin in release notes: "Partial pin: /batch-infer -> v8.9.3 during canary due to redis timeout on eu-c-11; no rollback." Will file follow-up ticket INFRA-5987 to revert pin and harden kvcache backoff.
maya_ops: bumping canary to 40% now, will wait 12m then push to 80% if stable.
deploy-bot: Canary percent increased to 40% (id=cb-1768301111) by maya_ops at 1768301200.
alert-bot: ephemeral watch created: /checks/1768301111/watch-1 (conditions: /batch-infer 5xx delta >10 OR p95 >20%)
tom_sre: snapshot saved to /runs/1768301111/obs_snapshot.json and traces to /runs/1768301111/traces.tgz
olga_release: thumbs if ok to continue to 80% after 12m with no alerts :thumbsup:
maya_ops: :thumbsup:
tom_sre: :thumbsup:
